text:
[issue by FrostBiteA426]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

(Neoforge 1.21.1) Attempting to load every beta version of JEI starting from Beta 19.32.0.358 causes the game to crash when attempting to join a world. Tested from Beta 19.32.0.358 to latest beta 19.39.0.368. All seem to cause a crash while using modpack. Cannot replicate crashes using JEI on its own. Cannot replicate crashes without JEI enabled in modpack.

[A-426 (1.21.1 NF).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30062078/A-426.1.21.1.NF.zip)

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

_No response_

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

Neoforge 1.21.1

### Extra Notes (Optional)

I'm not sure what's causing these crashes but I assume something added/patched to JEI over the last week or two might be conflicting with another mod.

### Crash Report

https://gist.github.com/FrostBiteA426/bea876e060d23fe5762dc3f9b2003882

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!
This crash is caused by JEIOptimizer 1.0.6 mixing into JEI internals with an outdated IngredientFilter constructor signature. JEIOptimizer has already updated for JEI 19.39.0.368 in version 1.0.7. Please update JEIOptimizer or remove it from the pack.
